meta.title: Agent SDK Bridge
meta.description: Adds Qoder CN, Qoder International and CodeBuddy subscription models to DeepSeek Harness through each provider's own SDK and local CLI login, with quota cards, per-model switches and a context-window choice. Open Settings → Qoder CN, Settings → Qoder International or Settings → CodeBuddy; no API key is required. The plugin reuses the CLI session on this machine and does not store credentials or install a CLI. Turning an edition off in the plugin's own options removes its settings page, model group and provider route.
